criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Flags wildfire disclosure issue as repeat of prior Filing MERI-2023-007

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies 'regular mail' terminology is imprecise vs. required 'first-class mail'
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 8 identifies 'regular mail' against the first-class mail required by C.R.S. 10-4-403(4) and notes it could include standard or bulk mail.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies missing electronic delivery option for cancellation notices
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 8 flags that the form has no consented electronic-delivery option under 10-4-403(4).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies missing mandatory replacement cost coverage offer
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 5 identifies 10-4-110.4, the ACV default in Section V, Condition 3, and the passive reference to MCP-RC-01 in place of an affirmative offer.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Notes that optional endorsement reference is insufficient for mandatory offer
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 5 explains that a reference to an optional endorsement does not meet the requirement for an offer in the form or in a mandatory notice.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies terrorism coverage disclosure lacks required specificity
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 11 identifies that Exclusion 14 lacks the premium, the federal share and the insurer deductible required by Reg. 4-2-41 and TRIPRA.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies one-year suit limitation conflicts with Colorado statute
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 16 notes the one-year clause against Colorado's three-year contract limitation under 13-80-101(1)(a), but it expressly leaves enforceability open for later research. It never says the clause is unenforceable or void.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Correctly identifies the applicable Colorado limitations period as 3 years
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 16 states that the general Colorado limitation for contract actions is three years and cites C.R.S. 13-80-101(1)(a).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007a: Identifies coinsurance clause lacks required plain-language explanation
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 10 identifies that Section V, Condition 5 lacks the plain-language explanation required by Reg. 4-2-22.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007b: Identifies coinsurance clause lacks required numerical example
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 10 identifies the missing dollar/numerical example required by Reg. 4-2-22.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies proof of loss deadline is 30 days instead of required 60 days
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 4 identifies the 30-day proof of loss in Condition 6(g) against the 60 days required by C.R.S. 10-4-105.2, calls it half the minimum, and notes the risk of forfeiture.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies appraisal provision missing umpire selection fallback mechanism
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 9 identifies the missing umpire fallback in Condition 9 and quotes the Reg. 4-2-28 language: a judge selects the umpire if the appraisers fail to agree within 15 days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Flags that readability testing has not been performed
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 3 flags that readability testing has not been done, cites Reg. 4-2-13 (Flesch 40 / F-K grade 12), and treats the certificate as a SERFF filing prerequisite and procedural item.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies mold exclusion lacks required exception for fire-related mold
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 17 identifies the absolute Mold exclusion in Exclusion 9 as having no exception for mold from a covered fire or firefighting water, as a deviation less favorable than the 10-4-105 standard fire policy, and recommends a carve-back.
